description: This Kotlin source file defines the HomeActivity class for an Android TV application. It manages the main TV home screen UI, including a top menu and multiple horizontal content rails, handling focus navigation with D-pad, dynamic content loading, and interactions such as clicking and focus animations.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: Main activity for the TV Home screen, managing UI setup, focus navigation, and dynamic content loading.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, setting up the layout, top menu, rails, and triggering data loading.

methods.name: setupTopMenu
methods.description: Configures the top menu UI with focusable items and click actions.

methods.name: setupRails
methods.description: Creates and populates horizontal content rails, handles focus behavior, image loading, and focus remapping on DPAD_UP.

methods.name: handleDpadUpWithinRails
methods.description: Handles remapping of focus upward navigation within content rails, moving focus to the corresponding item in the row above, or default behavior at top boundary.
